The firm's efficiency ratio 3 was 59.4% for the first nine months of 2026, compared with 62.1% for the first nine months of 2025. The increase in operating expenses compared with the third quarter of 2025 primarily reflected significantly higher transaction based expenses and higher compensation and benefits expenses (reflecting improved operating performance). In addition, charitable contributions to Goldman Sachs Gives (in other expenses) were significantly higher. Net provisions for litigation and regulatory proceedings were $ 23 million for the third quarter of 2026, compared with $ 131 million for the third quarter of 2025. Headcount increased 3% compared with the end of the second quarter of 2026, reflecting the timing of campus hires.
